invariants.rationale: HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to be returned when the method completes normally.
The preppedRecords list must be non-null or the method would likely not behave correctly.
The instantTime parameter should represent a valid point in time and is used as a key in write operations.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required for engine operations in the method.
The result should always contain a non-null List of WriteStatus objects.
